title: Collatz: source-dependent Mersenne progress and Lean residual proposal
body:
## What this continuation proves

The previous least-reverse-defect proposal left higher-rank progress open, and uniform fixed-word exploration reached a finite obstruction. This continuation follows each ordinary source for an exponent-dependent number of steps and proves new Mersenne family exclusions. It also constructs cofinal progressing sources at unbounded exact upper ranks and gives a finite joint-grid transfer core. **Collatz remains open.**

**[Scientific packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/README.md)** · **[final Lean proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/FinalProgressProposal.lean)** · **[execution and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/README.md)** · **[source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/SOURCES.json)**.

Baseline: `b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd`. Three GPT-6.2 Astra delegates used **ultra** reasoning effort. The focused source comparison refreshed current heads for the related branches; the 30-PR intake is a metadata inventory, not a correctness audit of all open work. The preceding [PR description](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/PRIOR_PR_DESCRIPTION.json) and all earlier mathematical files are preserved.

## 1. Two checkpoints beyond the uniform-word obstruction

In the remaining three-odd family, write

```text
j = 97 + 162m,         81z + 527 = 1024 * 2^j.
```

The prior bounded return and first-index theorem imply that a least reverse defect here has first bad Mersenne exponent j. Two strictly smaller directed queries now give actual ordinary nonbasin checkpoints

```text
3^q - 5,        2^r * 3^s - 17,
q = 67 + 108m,  k = floor((j-1)/11),  r = (j-1) mod 11,  s = 3 + 7k.
```

The proof consumes the full source-dependent expanding runs. It does not infer a pointwise orbit from a limiting completion.

- **One-sixteenth of each previously unresolved ternary class is excluded in Lean.** If m = 3 mod16, eight more steps from the first checkpoint meet eight from `3^(q+2)-1`. Since `0 < q+2 < j`, the earlier Mersenne orbit is good. The new closure combines this with the actual proved quantitative return. Coprimality with `3^10` makes the same fraction available inside each of the 58,049 classes outside the old bank.
- **A second explicit infinite progression is excluded in Lean.** For every `m = m0 + 2^284*t`, with the exact m0 defined in [MersenneRescueCylinder.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/MersenneRescueCylinder.lean), the second checkpoint meets an earlier Mersenne orbit within at most 285 additional steps on each arm. All eleven cases, starting congruences, period congruences, positivity bounds and ordinary witnesses are proved in the kernel. [MersenneProgressCases.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/MersenneProgressCases.lean) closes the least-defect case.
- **Source-qualified density-one consequence.** PR146's pinned symbolic fixed-gap estimate implies that only `O(M/sqrt(log(2M)))` parameters in an interval of M fail a sufficient first-checkpoint merger by `floor(log2 M)` additional steps. This holds uniformly on every positive odd-stride progression, including the old ternary classes. The imported estimate is written mathematics, not a new Lean probability theorem, and it leaves any prescribed exceptional parameter unresolved.

On increasingly precise subprogressions of the second family, the first checkpoint can miss every earlier ternary-power orbit through any prescribed finite deadline. The written proof and exact replay show why the second checkpoint supplies a distinct mechanism. No all-time nonmerger of one source is asserted. [Checkpoint proof and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/TWO_CHECKPOINT_RESCUE.md).

The calibrated signed potential also makes the uniform affine query quotient complete for arbitrarily long fixed words. It leaves exactly the two starting queries and no further query from their successor states. This boundary concerns words legal on every sufficiently large member of the whole exponent progression; it does not prohibit the new exponent-dependent clocks. [Uniform quotient](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/UNIFORM_MERSENNE_QUOTIENT.md).

## 2. Every finite lower word extends to genuine ordinary progress

For every q >= 2, binary word W of length a, exact upper rank R >= q+44+2a, and source bound L, Lean constructs z >= L and odd t > 0 with

```text
z = 17 mod48,          81z + 271 = 2^(q+7)*t,
3z first reaches 1 with exactly R odd inputs,
T^7(z) = 2^q*t-1,
```

followed by q odd inputs, one halving and the prescribed word W. Its continuation gives

```text
n = T^(2q+48+2a)(z) > 0,      2^40*n < z,      Basin(n) iff Basin(z).
```

[PositiveWordDescent.dense_progress](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/PositiveWordDescent.lean) proves the entire existence statement. The pointwise delayed-tail theorem applies directly to any supplied source passing its finite test; the construction theorem shows such progressing sources are cofinal in every finite post-ascent cylinder. It does not show that an arbitrary fixed member passes the test. [Quantifiers and proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/WORD_REALIZATION.md).

## 3. The analytic target is one joint finite grid

The [LiftedLattice kernel](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/LiftedLattice.lean) proves common-lift identities, labelled-fibre inclusion in actual merger components, at most `M^2(h+1)^2` exceptional lifts, exact equality away from those exceptions, and a source occupancy count. The written application retains all clocks and one admissible seed pair on the same binary residue grid before pulling the count back to the original selected parents.

At h = floor(d/3), the incomplete-period error is exponentially small. Under the named inherited population inputs, a counterexample forces the joint grid event to have mass >> d^-3 infinitely often. The opposing o(d^-3) upper remains open. A single-clock deficiency lower bound of order sqrt(r/h) for every odd stride rules out the naive marginal target in the relevant regime; shared future bits also prevent multiplying marginal estimates. [Full grid transfer](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/156652e03fe7a78f9cd4442039779cc622fdf3de/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/source-progress/GRID_TRANSFER.md).

The Aaronson–Yolcu–Heule connection remains exact rewrite and ordinary termination reasoning. Existing labelled-image compression literature is credited; no rediscovered entropy bound or full rewrite-system termination proof is claimed.

## 4. Exact remaining Lean obligation

```lean
theorem collatz_from_residual
    (residual : ResidualExclusion) : UniversalConvergence

theorem collatz_iff_residual :
    UniversalConvergence ↔ ResidualExclusion
```

The consumer chooses an actual least reverse defect, uses the proved quantitative return to eliminate the two-odd and finite-tail cases, and dispatches both newly proved Mersenne families. **ResidualExclusion is OPEN:** every remaining least defect with a genuine upper hit must still be eliminated. It is an explicit theorem argument, not an added axiom or an established result.

## Executed verification

- Fresh root compilation of **29 mathematical modules plus two audit modules** under Lean 4.34.1 and Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`; all local objects were rebuilt from source. One worker, automatic implicit binders disabled, warnings as errors. The sum of the final successful invocations across sequential batches is **801.764 seconds**; this is not claimed as one uninterrupted script run.
- **152 distinct public declarations audited: 100 inherited and 52 new.** Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. Explicit mathematical inputs remain inputs.
- **Ten exact finite executions:** four author checkers and one independently authored checker, each normal and optimized with identical paired stdout. Coverage includes 311 complete literal first hits, 93 symbolic dense-descent cases, all eleven rescue rows, 1,680 literal finite graphs, and 90 independently reconstructed sources.
- Independent reviews of the arithmetic, ordinary realization, source census and final consumer. A separate reviewer rebuilt the final cylinder and both consumers and independently recomputed the eleven modular rows.
